'''Maurice "Moe" Harkless''' is an American basketball player, most recently playing for [[St. John's]].

{{commons|Category:Moe Harkless|Moe Harkless}}

==High School==
In Moe's sophomore and junior seasons at [[Forest Hills High School]], Moe earned all-metro honors from both the [[New York Daily News]] and [[New York Post]]. In his junior season at Forest Hills, he was also named the New York Daily News Queens High School Player of the Year after averaging 16.5 points and 11.5 rebounds per game. Moe played at [[South Kent High School]] his senior year and averaged 27.2 points, 13.6 rebounds and 4.2 assists per game.<ref>{{cite web|title=Moe Harkless Profile|url=http://www.redstormsports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/harkless_moe00.html|work=St. John's University official athletic site|accessdate=19 June 2012}}</ref>

==College career==
In Moe's freshman season at St. John's, he averaged 15.5 points and 8.6 rebounds per game. He was also named the [[Big East Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year]]. Following his freshman season at St. Johns, Moe declared for the [[2012 NBA Draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Moe Harkless leaving St. John's Red Storm early for NBA Draft|url=http://espn.go.com/new-york/story/_/id/7709890/moe-harkless-leaving-st-john-red-storm-early-nba-draft|work=espn.go.com|accessdate=19 June 2012}}</ref>
